children: Nasdaq-listed Newgenivf disclosed that it sold all 146,400 XRP it bought during 2025, making a profit of about $10,800. According to Odaily, the company also traded small amounts of BTC and ETH during the same period and ended the year with a loss of about $1.28 million, while retaining about 13,000 SOL.

title: Newgenivf Sells 146,400 XRP and Holds About 13,000 SOL After 2025 Crypto Trades
